title: Meet this language
summary: See where the language came from, what it is related to, and how it connects to languages you already know.

tree.title: Where it comes from
tree.body: The highlighted language is your focus. The other branches come from languages you know when possible, with a few references added only when the tree needs more context.

compare.title: Languages in your head
compare.body: Related languages can give you useful shortcuts, but similar family history does not make them interchangeable.

focus.title: Your focus language
focus.body: Here are the details that matter most for the language you are learning.

complete.title: You have the map
complete.body: Now we can use what you already know as the course grows around you.
